intent: The compact action row on a chat message: copy, retry or edit, thumbs up / down with reasons, and a More menu. Icon Buttons with Tooltips.
useWhen: actions under an assistant or user message
collect quick feedback on a reply
show actions only on hover or focus in a dense thread
doNotUseWhen: a menu on its own — DropdownMenu

copied.note: Shows Copied in place of copy.

visible.note: hover: shown on hover or focus of the row or of an ancestor with data-message-actions-host.

requirements: the buttons sit in role=toolbar named by label
every icon Button has an accessible name and a Tooltip
thumbs are toggle buttons with aria-pressed
hover-only rows still show on keyboard focus and always show under prefers-reduced-motion
built-in labels (copy, retry, edit, goodResponse, badResponse, moreActions, whatWentWrong) come from KitLabelsProvider; English by default

doNot: Do not invent a local MessageToolbar or ChatActions
Do not use icon-only buttons without names
Do not put a solid primary Button in the row
snippet: <MessageActions onCopy={copy} onRetry={retry} onFeedback={setFeedback} feedback={feedback} moreItems={[{ id: "pin", label: "Pin message", icon: "Pin" }]} onAction={act} />
